name: apexyard-approve
description: Opt-in approval pane for an ApexYard ops fork: shows repo, PR, head SHA, CI state and Rex verdict, and sends Approve through the AgDR-0234 menu hook. It never writes a marker and never merges.

waiting_window_days.title: Waiting window (days)
waiting_window_days.description: List a Rex-approved PR only when its Rex marker is newer than this number of days.
